name: ghost-files
description: Retro-terminal desktop file manager for Windows

scripts.build: npm run check && npm test && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack: npm run check && npm test && electron-packager . GhostFiles --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite
scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check renderer.js && node --check preload.js && node --check file-ops.js

author: Andrey
